nom: SUNDAY RILEY 5 Stars Retinoid & Niacinamide Eye Serum

avis.titre: wanted to love, caused skin burns instead
avis.texte: I've only used this product morning and night for about 3 days now, and I woke up this morning with skin burns and discoloration around my eyes where the product was applied. you can visually see the burns. my eyes felt SUPER dry, so I tried to put some of my usual eye products on and it burned so bad. I had to resort to Vaseline as it was the only thing I could handle. I want my money back tbh. I'm going to try to post pictures if possible.
I have been usung this Retinol for over a year. I do not have sensitive skin. Firming and brightening. Non- irriating. I also put this all over my face.

avis.titre: wanted to love this SO BAD!
avis.texte: let me first say that i LOVE the sunday riley brand, and have recently been loving their niacinamide "B3 Nice" serum for helping with fine lines and signs of aging. when i saw this undereye cream from them, i was THRILLED… but sadly not for long. unfortunately after 3 uses, my undereyes became extremely flakey, red, and dry. i went to cleanse my face in the morning and the skin around the outer corner was sensitive to the touch and literally began to flake off, as though it was chapped. i have very dry skin and get eczema outbreaks on my face sometimes - this was a worse experience than even that. i returned this product, and i had NEVER returned a product to ulta before this. i feel like my undereye bags/wrinkles were WORSE than they were before. very disappointed with this product, but still a big fan of sunday riley overall.

avis.titre: Too harsh for the under eyes area
avis.texte: I got this product from the PM trial set, and it is the only one that I will recommend avoiding. It was great for the first week; my fine lines were gone and the skin looked hydrated and soft. After that week, my under eye area would burn every time my eyes teared or applied my day time eye cream, and I got dry and red spots. I kept using it for a few more days, but it just kept getting worse. I stopped using it and waited until my skin had healed to apply it again. The burning and redness was back next morning. If it wasn't because of the burning and drying, this will be my favorite eye cream because it actually erased my fine lines.
After you get through the initial ease your way in period with retinol, this stuff is great. Best under eye retinol I've used. I'm always open to trying new products and so far nothing compares!

This retinol cream, containing a potent 6%! causes significant burning and irritation to the delicate under-eye skin as well as discomfort in the eyes themselves! User beware. This should be recalled.

I use many Sunday Riley products. This is the only product I feel is terrible. I tested on my forearm for 4 days and no sensitivity. I used a tiny amount under my eyes as instructed. It causes swelling and redness and it takes days to subside. Other reviews suggest the same terrible side effects.

Yes, it has a retinol so you are going to have to ease in and get through a little dryness and flaking at first. But after that, WOWAH! This is the ONLY eye cream that has changed the skin around my eyes & made it super smooth, super hydrated, depuffed and less wrinkled

This does smooth lines. I use it only at night. I like it, but find that I have to back off a bit after a week or so of use and use a more moisturizing cream around the eyes to combat dryness. It's good and potent, but expensive. I wouldn't pay full price for it.

My eyes are sensitive to many eye creams & this is now my FAVORITE! The tiny lines around my eye area are reduced & softened and applying my concealer goes on so much smoother…I then apply the C.E.O. Brightening Serum & my morning ritual is set…I love this entire product Sunday Riley line!

I tried the samples ( i got about 5 ) you get when you order direct from Sunday Riley and so far love the product i wear it over their auto correct eye cream for eye puffiness and this eye serum works great for moisturizing . Only con is its expensive for such a small tube and its never included in their bestseller sales.

Amazing product. If I use too much I become sensitive to it. Work your way up to it but it's very effective. My lines are gone. I found my balance in how I use/ incorporate it in my routine. Will repurchase

I do not usually write reviews, but felt this one needed it. After using the eye cream two days in a row, I started having a burning sensation around my eyes. I blamed sun exposure, stress, and other irritants. I did stop using the eye cream for about a month and then used it again, same thing, burning, irritation, dryness. I can now confidently pinpoint the eye cream as the culprit. Burning, itchy, dryness and even scaly dry spots around my eyes! I would not recommend this product for anyone with normal to sensitive skin. I do not consider my skin sensitive.

avis.titre: Horrible swelling and rash around eyes!
avis.texte: I received this as a sample from another order and have never had any skin reactions before this. I followed the directions and hardly used a pea size for each under eye. I woke up with two horrible swollen and painful eyes. I am going on day 2 and am still swollen under my left eye. Would not recommend.

I'm in your older women category and absolutely love this eye treatment. I'm having issues with bags and dark circles that drive me bonkers. Started using this eye serum and can tell you it absolutely changes the game.

avis.titre: Avoid this product on your eyes
avis.texte: I used an entire tube of this and started to notice my under eye area looking more wrinkled than usual. I became concerned and went to see a Dermatologist. I was told that I should never use a retinoid on any part of the eye area because its way to thin to handle such a strong ingredient. This product will only age you so if thats not your jam I would pass.

avis.titre: Burns like you put pepper around your eyes
avis.texte: I purchased this cream as part of the CH kit with high expectations, only to be sorely disappointed. Despite having used similar products like SR in the past and maintaining a good skincare routine, this cream proved to be an entirely different experience. Within a minute of application, the burning sensation was so intense that it felt like I had accidentally rubbed raw peppers onto my eye. Not only did it cause inflammation and redness around my eye and the adjacent area of my cheek, but it was also excruciatingly painful. Despite rinsing it off immediately with cool water and applying an ice compress, the discomfort persisted. Reluctantly, I attempted to use it again, this time layering it over a plain moisturizer devoid of any acids or additives, yet the result was the same – an unbearable burning sensation akin to fire ants. This product is not just disappointing; it poses a significant risk to one's skin health and safety.
I love the brand but this product burned my eyes. It took days for my eyes to feel better.

When I saw just now that this serum only has 3.3 stars, I gasped, as I almost never buy anything with less than a 4.5 star review and what a catastrophe it would be if my first opinion on this product was based on the 3.3 stars here, omg, I would have bought something else and missed out on my holy grail!!! So, I can only hope that my review will help someone out there like me. I fortunately received a full size tube in an Allure beauty box over a year ago and started using it morning and evening. When it was gone, I thought, eh, it was ok but did it do anything…? I wasn't convinced and with this stuff being a little pricey, I went back to my previous favorite once the 5 Stars tube was gone. After a couple weeks, I noticed my eye area was looking a little dull, crepey, and tired…so I doubled up on my old favorite for another week, drank more water, and tried to get more sleep. By the end of the third week, I had had enough. I looked like I'd aged ten years over the last few weeks!!! So off to Ulta I went to buy this magical 5 Stars Eye Serum just on the hunch that maybe it actually had been doing something magical, as I was now desperate to put an end this sudden maddening turn of events. I think we all may expect to see drastic quick results when you start something new and when nothing happens over night, we get a little negative, but like Grandma always said, good things come to those who wait, and dang if she wasn't right. Over the course of 45 days, this serum had brough

I was using this while using a lash serum. I got what i assume to be a chemical burn (skin peeling off, intense burning, exc) i blamed it on the lash serum. I stopped using products to let my skin heel and just reintroduced this again and my skin burns so bad. This makes my skin incredibly tight, painful to the touch and painful when i make facial expressions. Its crazy! I wouldn't recommend this

avis.titre: Good but not good enough for the $
avis.texte: I recieved this either in some type of beauty box or surplus gratis from my friend who works at an Ulta beauty. My skin is 2 years used to retinol/retinoids alternating with low and high strength. This eye cream is decent, I do really like the consistency and the applicator is a fave. It is pale yellow in color which yes - this is a STRONG retinoid! I use it only 1/2 to 3/4 of my retinol nights. When I looked this up for a re-purchase though… ouch on the price point. I'll look elsewhere for similar products.

my dermatologist recommended that I take niacinamide a few years ago. When I saw that the 5-Start Eye Serum included niacinamide and knowing that my fine lines are making a new home around my eyes, I thought... why not? this is an excellent eye cream - a little bit goes a long way. Soothing, no irritation and positive results (fine line reduction)
This stuff BURNED my eyes so bad. The associate told me it's.great for under eye under my concealer. I went outside in 90' weather and that was a bad mistake! I now have dry, burning, inflamed eyes.

avis.titre: Please research stuff before using it
avis.texte: People seem to just use stuff and blame the product for not being informed lol this is retinol and SR uses a high quality type that's what makes their products so loved. This one is made for the eyes but it's still retinol and eye skin is thinner and more delicate so you have to gently work your way up to it. Use it once or twice a week and work your way up over time if you have sensitivity to it and as with anything patch test before use! I've had such amazing results from this it really helped my dark circles and thin skin. If you use too much it'll dry you out and make the eyes look worse bc of that so find a good balance. I do 3-4 nights a week after using it over a year but I also take a week break every other month and just do toner serum lotion and have great results.

After a couple of days of use, my eyes burned and the skin became red, inflamed, itchy and extremely uncomfortable to the point that I can't use any eye make-up. I threw the tube in the garbage and have been using aquaphor (recommended by my dermatologist) to help the skin heal. I have never experienced this type of reaction to a product before, but I think the chemicals in the serum are too strong for some people.

avis.titre: Definitely reduces lines, but go slowly trying it out
avis.texte: I got this to try out and was initially disappointed and how much burning it caused around my eyes. It took several days of stopping usage for relief to set in. Then I read more about retinol and realized that I needed to start slowly (applying once a week, not daily!) to give my skin a chance to acclimate. I'm so glad I did! I can definitely tell a difference - reduction in crows feet at the corners of my eyes. And I only use it 2-3 times a week right now. This product should be used at night (to avoid sunlight exposure of the retinoids) and you may need to start using it just weekly and work up to a few nights a week. It's too bad that the instructions don't tell you that. This is one that you have to give some time to get the full results. But I think it''s worth it!

avis.titre: Use daily without drying out your under eyes!
avis.texte: Love this product has helped me out so much with my dark circles and under eyes. Not only has it gotten rid of crissage but has also brightened my under eyes as well!
So far I don't notice a difference in fine lines or dark circles however it feels amazing on. I will continue to use and hopefully will notice a positive change.

I really appreciate the packaging, and the applicator tip that feels like a mini massage when you put it on. I havent experienced any burning or dry skin, but I have noticed I look more refreshed on mornings after I use it!

avis.titre: Dry flaky skin after two nights of use
avis.texte: I LOVE Sunday Riley products and use the CEO serum, A++, Luna oil and Good Genes. I wanted to love this product, but it causes redness, tenderness, and dry flaky skin around my eyes. I use it once a week now and that seems fine, but I have to alternate with something else. NOT for sensitive skin apparently
I have used this product for the last two weeks and it has burned my under eyes only using it three/four times the last two weeks. Will not be re purchasing.

This is my second full-sized tube after getting this in one of the bundles. I use it at night, and the cooling and soothing qualities feel so great right before bed. I wake up looking like I've slept!!
I love this product! It works great on my dark circles/bags. I find it to be moisturizing but I do use it with a moisturizer and an HA.

I have to be very careful when using this product. I use it 1-2x / week after buffering with eye cream. If I apply more often, it does burn my eyelids and undereyes. I should probably just chuck it, but perhaps it's doing something. My eye area looks pretty good for someone my age. I'm on my second tube, I think, but I will not repurchase.

I have been trying this eye cream for months now and have combed through reviews and wow I couldn't believe the amount of negative reviews. Especially the burning, peeling, cracked skin, etc...so I wanted to understand is it a sensitive skin issue or a certain ingredient perhaps....I noticed this is a retinoid. In general, retinoids are stronger than retinol. They contain a higher concentration of the product, and the molecular structure of vitamin A in this form allows it to turn over skin cells at a faster rate than retinol. So if you haven't incorporated a retinol into your skincare, I wouldn't start with this one or cut it with another moisturizing cream. The niacinamide, and retinoid are high up on the ingredient deck with other beautiful ingredients so I understand that's how they justify the price. Beautiful packaging.

This is a great eye cream, definitely worth easing into as it can be very drying, I use it about 2-3 days in a row then take a day off, but I have noticed a difference in the appearance of fine lines and the overall feeling of the skin around my eyes, I've been using it now about 5 months. That said: PLEASE DESIGN BETTER PACKAGING!!!! The top falls off if you so much as look at it wrong and whenever I take it with me to travel in my travel case the top comes loose or falls off and I've probably lost as much product this way as I've actually put on my eyes. It's 2023 and there is absolutely no reason for a product this expensive to come in a tube with such a flimsy and insecure top.
My eyes became very dry after two nights. This is not what I expected. Its not doing anything other than making my eyes dry.
The fine lines at the corners of my eyes were visible reduced within weeks.

avis.titre: Be cautious! It's a retinoid product.
avis.texte: I got this in the night time kit. I havent experiencd the same burning or irritation that others have even though I have sensitive skin. If you have never used a retinol, you should start using the product very gradually or you will experience redness and burning and peeling. Not just with this eye cream but any one with retinol. So the issue might not be this product but your skin is not used to it yet.

I seen this product all over tiktok and wanted to see if it would help with the milia under my eyes but this product burned my skin so bad, around all my eyes it was just red for days and peeling and so dry. Overall I really wanted this to work but was very disappointed with the results especially seeing the price point on this. Save your money

avis.titre: Caused redness an irritation within 3 days
avis.texte: I was super excited about the product description, but after using it twice (on consecutive nights) I started feeling some tenderness and irritation around my eyes. It wasn't severe so I used it a third night, but waking up the next morning the tenderness and irritation had become significant and I had noticeable redness. The skin around my eyes felt unbearably itchy and it took almost a week for the irritation to completely subside. I'm sure this product would reduce wrinkles if you're lucky enough to not suffer the irritation, but IMO this is a terrible product!
I had milia under my eyes and puffy under eyes and this has helped just within the two weeks of buying! Worth purchasing!
Burns instantly made my whole eye puff up. I had to wash it off

avis.titre: Retinoid + Niacinamide Eye Serum is THE BEST
avis.texte: This eye serum is amazing! Many companies advertise their products can perform "miracles" on crow's feet and wrinkles under the eye. But this serum is for real! I cannot believe the difference already, and I've only been using it for a little over a week.
This product is great around my eye area and doesn't irritate my eyes like other retinols do.

I used a tony amount under each eye at bedtime for about 5 nights. I would normally use more but I was cautious after reading the many mixed reviews. Within 2 days my under eye area was dried out and concealer looked awful. I had to keep gently dabbing moisturizer on throughout the day. I thought it was the new concealer I'd bought but I realized it was the eye serum when the skin starting flaking and peeling off. I've never reacted to a product like this before. I purchased the night time kit and was super disappointed that I couldn't return it since it was part of a set.
I started this 2 times per week, and my eye under eyes are very sensitive now, and it burns when i use Auto Correct in the morning following my use of 5 Stars the evening before.
Purchased this so that I can use in the evening and Auto Correct in the morning.

I bought this product as a bundle deal with the A+ high dose retinol. It's a very cooling gel like cream. I did not feel that it dried out or irritated my eye area, on the contrary it was very refreshing. The applicator from which the product is dispensed from is very cooling on the skin.
love love love love I have sensitive skin and this doesn't cause irritation like many other products I've tried around the eyes
Been using it from a sample and could really see the difference in the fine lines around my eyes. Had to buy it after the sample was gone because it worked so well.
Have bought this item three times now. I read before using and knew I needed to build up a tolerance to start. Absolutely love the result and will continue to use.
Do NOT use this more than once a week! It will burn you badly!
I got this with the bedtime routine kit. Used it for just a couple of days. Developed red, pealing spots under and beside my eyes. Burns. And feels super tight? It did not work for me.

avis.titre: Works but caused itchy burn on and under eyes
avis.texte: Product works but my normally tough skin had a reaction to it.
I can't tell you enough how much it causes the bottom of your eyes to burn and peel . It's practically swollen under my eyes and even concealer burns to put on . This should NOT be sold
I bought this product and by day 3 my skin burns so bad around my eyes. I can't even touch it. Also my eyes are super watery and burning.

avis.titre: One of the only eye creams that work for me
avis.texte: I love this product! I don't understand the bad reviews because my under eyes have been soft, noticeably less wrinkled and brighter than before I was using this. Like with any retinol product, you should build up a tolerance so I usually use 2-3 times a week tops! I also avoid if my skin is over dry or I have an eczema flare up, and have had zero issues.

Caused tender, red, puffy under eyes for me after several days of daily use. I'm seeing a number of other reviews that say this as well. My under eyes look way worse than before and sting when I apply even regular lotion.

avis.titre: Burned my skin under my eyes
avis.texte: Been using this product for 5 days and my under eyes are red, burned, itchy, stingy and flaky. The first couple of days the skin felt tight but now they feel burned! 0 Stars

I absolutely love this eye cream & cannot believe all the bad reviews! I find this to be very cooling and refreshing when i apply. Feels like cucumber slices on my eyes :) after 3 weeks i'd say my eye wrinkles are about 90% gone.. i love pressing the remaining serum between my eyebrows and have seen my wrinkles there start to go away too!
Made the tissue on my eyelids and the under eye puffy and crepey like a mild chemical burn. Returned.
I've tried all Sunday Riley products and have LOVED them , but this product made the corner of my eyes raw , burning sensations , and also caused peeling. I wouldn't suggest !

I started using the travel sample I received and really liked the results so recently purchased the full size. The application wand is nice and cooling when I apply the eye cream, it absorbs quickly and isn't oily. I noticed a reduction in the appearance of my crows feet and fine lines. I love this product and recommend it to everyone. My eyes no longer look fatigued in the morning and my friends have noticed the results.
Feels so cool and luxurious. I prefer tube eye creams over jar creams, much cleaner and easier to use. Haven't used it long enough to know how effective it is on wrinkles.
I used this a couple times and had to return it because it burned my skin so much. I wasn't even able to touch my eyes or else I'd regret it.

I was so excited for this product but unfortunately after two uses, the skin under my eyes is fried. Looks like a sunburn. My skin has been burning for days and my eyes are so watery. I don't even have sensitive skin!

My face is in so much pain from this product. I feel like I have chemical burns around my eyes. Even my vision is worse since starting to use it. Almost like it migrated into my eyes. DO NOT use if you even a smidge of sensitive skin.

I bought this serum about 4 weeks ago. I love Sunday Riley and I strongly feel it's worth it's prices. My first was good genes and that's just instant boost. This serum I have been using for about 4 weeks with my night routine- wash, dry, apply to dry skin with face retinol, wait 20 min, apply heavier Moisturizer or oil (I actually have CEO glow) and photos below show the change especially with my crows feet when smiling. It is not change in a day or two however it is noticeable.

The texture of the product is great but after a few days you realize that it completely burns the skin under your eyes. Maybe it depends on the type of skin but according to other reviews, it sounds like it happened to a lot of people. I would not recommend. Definitely not worth the price. Very disappointed.
Have only used it for several weeks and it has reduced my puffiness and lessens the lines under my eyes.
Terrible reaction, my skin started to peel. would not recommend for sensitive skin, even skipping days in between uses caused a bad reaction.
This is my second order and have been very pleased with the products!!
Feels like heaven as a night treatment !! I have less puffiness when I wake up, I'm going to use it for a month to see what the results are

This product (and all others I've tried!) is amazing!! It rolls on cool and feels soooo good. I've noticed tightening and smoothing around my eyes since I started using. I would HIGHLY recommend this product!!
I love this stuff. It's the first eye cream I've used that has visible results. I use it three times a week, simply because it's potent. I have very dry skin with some ingredient sensitivities,.

Every eye cream I have tried never worked until now. It it powerful yet sensitive enough whereas the tender tissue under my eyes can handle it. I wake up to no puffiness whatsoever and appear well rested
Have been using for over a year. Absolutely love! If you're new to retinoid then don't use every night at first. Work your way up to every night over time.

I really like this eye serum. It's lightweight and great to use at night. The only thing I don't like about this is the packaging. The tube is hard to use especially with the applicator. Sometimes it's a struggle to get product out. I think this cream would be better in a container!

Given 2 stars only because it's rare that such a potent product is so readily available and but my skin cannot tolerate this at all. I have used a scrip retinoid for 6 months now on my face with virtually no peeling or dryness so I thought this would be a nice addition to the areas where you're not allowed to put the scrip. Within 2 days my skin was raw and peeling around my eyes and took several days to heal and over a week to stop peeling. I'm scared to use this anywhere else.

It's always hard for me to tell if a product is really doing what it's supposed to, but I have to say I think this one does! I am almost finished with my first tube and feel like the skin under my eyes looks MUCH better. The wrinkles seem to have diminished and I feel like I look younger and less tired. I am buying this a second time. The tube lasts so long since you only use it at night. I have not experienced any drying or burning like other reviewers mentioned. It has been dreamy to apply this with the applicator on the tube and just smooth it on.

avis.titre: Horrible product — instant burning and pain!
avis.texte: Ouch. This eye cream sears your skin almost on contact. Painful burning kicked in for me after about 5 minutes — I removed the serum using micellar water then treated the area with super-gentle eye cream. But it still took hours to calm down. Huge NO.
I bought this hoping it would help, but after started using it my skin was peeling, irritated and burning. I had to stop using it and applied some coconut oil to the area.
Don't see much difference using it. It will go back. No worth the cost.

I bought this after I bought into all the paid TikTok influencers promoting this serum followed by all the beauty articles. In the end, it did absolutely nothing for me. I ended up throwing it away. Sadly, because I forgot I had already tried this brand, I bought into the advertising hype again and purchased their vitamin C serum but I'll be smarter and return that one before I even open it. Don't get it is my advice.

Struggled with dark circles and this helped minimize it drastically, starting out it can be potent and kinda burn but I just used it one day and used a different one the next day til I got used to it and started doing it everyday. My husband even noticed the difference!
This ruined my eyes and it burned. I had redness for over a week on my eyes. I have never had any problems with any other eye products. I DO NOT RECOMMEND

I had to try this because I saw it on Tik Tok, but it doesn't do much and just burns! The first week was fine but then the second week that's when my under eyes started to burn and it lasted mostly all day.

This eye cream destroyed my under eye area. I had welts and red patches that burned and hurt for a week. I use retinol so I'm not a newbie by any means - I know it can cause some dryness and flaking. However this was next level discomfort. Do not recommend at all - this stuff is awful!

I like this undereye serum. It helps moisturize and hydrate. I prefer roc retinol undereye cream but this works as an added step. If you have sensitive eyes and have never used retinol, I wouldn't advise using this, or perform the buffering method, mix this with a non retinol eye cream
I am the biggest Sunday Riley fan ever but this hurts my under eye area badly. It burns and dries out my skin. I do not recommend. I don't even have sensitive skin.
This product is wonderful! I use it every night and I wake up without dark circles and haven't had any bags under my eyes since. Highly recommend!!

I tried it out for two days and I this product burned my under eyes. :( I really wanted it to work but I maybe recommend reading through the ingredients before trying. My sister also tried it and it burned her as well.

Ive used this product on different days since I know retinoid can be strong but last time i used it was 3 days ago and this morning i woke up with chemical burn all over my under eye. And im not one to be sensitive with new skincare products. So yeah im tossing this out
I love Sunday Riley products but this one is not it! Too potent. Drys out the under eye and causes too much irritation to skin. Needs to be reevaluated.

I was so excited to use this product because I had some milia, however, it made my under eyes so sensitive. I applied only at night and then the next day my under eyes were red and burning when i tried to wash it off. Days later they are still sensitive and I cannot apply other eye creams which will make it worse until it is healed.

Used this for 2 weeks I thought it was normal for it to sing in the beginning because it's my first time using Rey retinoid, but it just got worse and worse!!! I haven't used it for a week and my eyes still burn even if when I put concealer on.
This product has left my eyes red, peeling, and super irritated to the point where they hurt. Absolutely will be returning.
I love SR and use almost every product they make. This gave me HORRIBLE milia (that was even painful to get removed!) and quite honestly did absolutely nothing for my fine lines.
I love this product I saw a recondition from a page I follow on instagram. It's an anzing product and my skin looks younger already
Wrinkles around eyes appear to look softer. A little goes a long way.
Nourishing and hydrating, it's been helping with my fine lines.

avis.titre: Dry under eyes with very dark cirlcles
avis.texte: I've tried every eye product out there and stumbled onto this one. This is so good, I've been using it nightly for about 2 months and the improvement is noticeable. My eye area is more firm, dark circles have lightened so less corrector and concealer is needed, and the fine lines around my eyes are much better. I have sensitive skin and haven't had any problems at all with this formula. Highly recommend and will definitely repurchase.
I bought it recommended by a fried and it is really good i am amazed how it minimized the fine lines and wrinkles. Absorbed and moisture very good. I will buy it again and i recommended it.
Really like this product, could tell a difference almost immediately! The only issue is that I've had a small rash but it cleared quickly!

So far, so good!! I love the cooling effect the applicator til offers… it's very refreshing! Looking forward to a few more weeks under my belt to see some improvements… I've only been using for about a week.

avis.titre: Very strong and caused burning for days
avis.texte: I received Sunday Riley's 5 stars in a beauty box and I was excited to try it. I used it for 4 nights and loved the way my eyes looked after but then on day 5 I washed my face and my eyes were stinging like crazy and it hasn't stopped 5 days later.. my lines look deeper and very dry. The burning sensation is pretty consistent even tho I stopped using it.

I have used eye creams for over 15 years. This is the only eye cream that actually does what it promises to do. My dark under eye circles are noticeably lighter and fine lines are substantially diminished. The total area is super soft to the touch and overall brighter in appearance. I'm a little iffy on SR products, but this one is now holy grail for me.

I have read bad reviews about this product, and I decided to write my experience. I have used it for over two weeks now (day and night). It came with my Allure box this month. I see improvements in my under eyes area—the product hydrate the area well. Every time I apply, my skin sucks the cream. I recommend giving this product a try. I'm thrilled with these results planning to keep using them. As usual, Sunday, Riley did it again! Great product!
The single most impactful product I've ever purchased. The puffiness under my eyes has been decreased tremendously, therefore looking well rested

This product works very well at improving fine lines and diminishing the look of dark circles however, the percentage of retinol in the product should not be ignored. I did not start slowly with this product, which resulted in irritation and sensitivity. I would recommend this product, but only to people with knowledge on retinol products.

I bought this eye cream a few weeks ago and noticed a difference right away. I have fine lines under my eyes and they are a little dark, specially if I didn't sleep well. After two weeks I noticeably see the fine lines reduced. I like the applicator too and its feels nice when applying the serum.

This product is way to strong. It's definitely not for every day use ! I used it like 3 days in a row woke up the 4th morning my eyes was swollen red and burning. I haven't used the product in like 2 days under my eyes are now peeling very swollen and red.
It's been five days and my under eyes are still red and cracked. I'm going to look into returning this item as it is far too strong
